title: Azusawa Kohane — American Style?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: New York Academy of Music - Backstreet

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Okay, I'll go with this composition...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I just need to adjust the aperture and set the exposure to...about this much.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I got it, An.
This is how it turned out...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow, that's amazing!
You could totally turn this into a movie poster.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I tried getting a little creative with the composition.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, next... Why don't we try both taking one, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Show me the way, Ms. Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay. I'll try my best to make things easy to understand.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, An, you really surprised me when you said that you wanted to learn more about photography.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I wanted to learn how to take better pictures since I've been going by feel until now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. You'll start taking good ones right away once you've gotten the hang of a couple things.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Starting with the rule of thirds.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The rule of thirds?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's a technique that involves laying a three-by-three grid over what you see. The idea is to align your subject to those lines.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By doing so, it becomes easier to take balanced photos.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see. That explains why it's called the rule of thirds.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
There should be a way to get your phone to show those lines.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, it can do that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Lemme see... Whoa, you're right!
This makes things so much easier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That just leaves how to use light sources.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The feel of your photo can really change based on where your light source is. A backlight can make things more dramatic, while light from the front can brighten up your image.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow! So if you use your light sources properly, you can take photos like a total pro!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kohane!
I'll try taking some pictures using the techniques you just taught me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great! I'm sure you'll know what I mean when you actually try it for yourself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
Can you stand in front of those plants for me, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A little more to your left... A little more... Stop! That's perfect!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, this looks good!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Get ready. Smile...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How'd they turn out, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane, you look extra cute!
You're amazing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Haha...
No, I think that means you did a good job of taking them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, can we take another one? This time with a different pose!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. So, what pose would you like me to do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
How about the one that clerk taught you?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Umm... Th-This one?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! You look super cool, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here's how it turned out. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The composition looks good and I like the way you used your light source... It is a little embarrassing, though.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehehe. You look way too cute!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm gonna take so many pictures of you moving forward, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've taken a ton of pictures since coming here, but the ones you take are always better. That's been bothering me a bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We have the luxury of you being our photographer, and we know you'll take a bunch of great pictures...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...
Do you want to become a better photographer because...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! I want to learn how to take amazing pictures of you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you. That's so sweet of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, while we're in the US, I'm gonna be your own personal photographer! And I promise to do a good job!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing what you take, An.
